ruleDefinitions.name: C# IL Code Compilation Via Ilasm.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of "Ilasm.EXE" in order to compile C# intermediate (IL) code to EXE or DLL.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\ilasm\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "ilasm\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/dll.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/exe.*")))
